brief: Offers a domain language model behind the language-model port, so a bounded, factual assistant needs no external model.
detail: Complete asks the model and returns the reply in the port's shape, with from set to dlm. It is a genuine local equivalent rather than a recording or a fake, so a service registry may ship it. It answers deterministically from the facts the model holds and refuses outside its domain with a sentence instead of inventing; that refusal still comes back as ok 1, so check the model's own Why to tell the two apart. The source keeps a copy of the model, so fill the model completely before handing it in.
receiver:
oDlm = new stzDLM("restaurant")
oDlm.LearnEntity("margherita", "dish")
o1 = new stzDlmSource(oDlm)
